Prime Minister Andy Burnham is initiating a devolution plan to grant English city regions a share of income tax and business rates, aiming to reduce reliance on central government grants.

The Poison:
Areas with weaker economies may struggle to generate sufficient revenue, potentially widening the gap between wealthy and struggling regions.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
The error is in the HOW: the plan assumes tax retention will automatically drive growth, ignoring the structural disparities between regions.

Social Physics Analysis:
By moving toward a model of shared revenue retention, the government is attempting to replace top-down dependency with a system that rewards local economic integration.

The Trajectory: The Path of Awakening.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Grace. The system moves toward a more stable, distributed equilibrium.

The Unavoidable Truth: Local control requires local economic viability.

The Unavoidable Lie: This will solve all regional inequality overnight.
